title: Concept: Dependency declared with a bare wildcard range
description: package.json declares a dependency specifier of `*`, which accepts every version the registry has ever published, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Any release, including one published after this manifest was reviewed, satisfies the declaration, so the install is not reproducible and a compromised publish is taken automatically.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: Any release, including one published after this manifest was reviewed, satisfies the declaration, so the install is not reproducible and a compromised publish is taken automatically.
